title: Enable Vulkan cloth Gallery domains
scope: Compile, bind and qualify existing shared Slang cloth, geometry-cloth and fluid-cloth schedules for the Vulkan driver.
acceptance: Cloth, tear, paint and cloth-water scenes pass bounded lifecycle and visible-output checks on Vulkan.
Vulkan advertises only the exact cloth and coupling capabilities supported by passing public-API contracts.
evidence: PASS: ./scripts/Test-Vulkan.sh -R 'vulkan-|gallery-input|gallery-workload|^parallel-mater-command-api-tests$|^parallel-mater-gallery-session-contract-tests$'; 32/32 selected tests passed on NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti with SDK 1.4.341.0 validation; docs/VULKAN.md
PASS: 120-frame public-command lifecycle checks for Cloth, ClothTear, ClothPaint, and ClothWater, including non-empty cloth paint; tests/gallery/command_gallery_tests.cpp and CMakeLists.txt
PASS: bounded common-session rendered-image qualification for all four Vulkan cloth scenes; tests/gallery/gallery_session_contract_tests.cpp
PASS: headless Vulkan Peg Paint reported 777 painted texels and Cloth Paint reported 2288 painted texels; docs/VULKAN.md
